QuestInfo.name: Fence
QuestInfo.0: Strong opponents are a crucial part of any succesful training. Go talk to Father.
QuestInfo.1: Father agrees that it's important to grow stronger, but says he values your safety more. For now, go get some rest.
QuestInfo.2: Your safety is important, of course, but if you want to accomplish your goals, you'll have to grow stronger eventually...
